Subject: Aurora Health — Exec workshop: attendee blocks & travel windows

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our conversation, we want to lock a two-day executive workshop the week of Dec 6 where Redwood will present the platform, run a hands-on ops runbook session with your cloud team, and host a leadership discussion on inference economics.

Two asks to get calendar holds out this week:
- Can you confirm which Aurora execs will attend in-person vs remote (we need final attendee list by Tue 11/24)?
- Please share travel windows / blackout dates for any execs who would require morning-only availability (we'll stagger sessions to accommodate PST/Eastern CET as needed).

Proposed onsite blocks (we'll publish firm times once we have attendee constraints):
- Day 1 (workshop + hands-on): 09:00–12:00 & 14:00–17:00 PT
- Day 2 (leadership & roadmap): 09:00–12:00 PT (shorter day for travel)

We'll set provisional calendar holds for Dec 7–8 and include a virtual overflow slot Dec 9 for follow-ups. If procurement needs to be looped (PO/tax forms), please let me know who to copy.

Attaching a draft agenda and our travel reimbursement guidelines for reference.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Thanks, Irene —

Dec 7–8 works in principle. Quick notes from our side:
- In-person: Elena Marquez (CEO), Greg Hsiao (CTO), Priya Menon (VP Cloud)
- Remote: CFO (only mornings EST), Head of Security (available afternoon CET)
- Procurement (Sandeep) will handle PO; please send any contract redlines to s.rao@aurorahealth.com

Blackout: Priya is traveling Dec 6–6 (red-eye back on evening of Dec 6) so she needs a later start on Dec 7. CFO has an investor meeting Dec 8 morning (EST) — prefer afternoon slot that day if possible.

We'd like onsite arrival targeted for morning Dec 7 (local time). Events will coordinate catering and rooms once we confirm headcount.

Elena
